mapper.select:
SELECT ORG_CODE "id", ORG_NAME "name",
DECODE(PARENT_ORG_CODE,null,'#org',PARENT_ORG_CODE) "pid",
(case PARENT_ORG_CODE when null then '#org' else PARENT_ORG_CODE end) "pid",
'org' as "type" FROM SYS_ORGANIZATION
DEL_IND = '0'
AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}

select ROLE_CODE "id", ROLE_NAME "name",
DECODE(PARENT_ROLE_CODE,null,'#role',PARENT_ROLE_CODE) "pid",
(case PARENT_ROLE_CODE when null then '#role' else PARENT_ROLE_CODE end) "pid",
'role' as "type" from sys_role
DEL_IND = '0'
AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}

select dept.DEPT_CODE "id", dept.DEPT_NAME "name",
DECODE(dept.PARENT_DEPT_CODE,null,rel.ORG_CODE,dept.PARENT_DEPT_CODE) "pid",
(case dept.PARENT_DEPT_CODE when null then rel.ORG_CODE else dept.PARENT_DEPT_CODE end) "pid",
'dept' as "type" from SYS_DEPARTMENT dept left join SYS_ORG_DEPT_REL rel on dept.DEPT_CODE = rel.DEPT_CODE
dept.DEL_IND = '0' AND rel.DEL_IND ='0'
AND dept.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}
